entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Our name did spread a bit[n]thanks to Madarame...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But I bet people still wouldn't[n]care if we came out and said[n]we're the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I doubt anyone would believe us.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Please don't. That may seem[n]like a fun idea for now...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But what good would come of[n]telling people our identities?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Maybe they'd at least start[n]treating us with some respect.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, I can understand[n]why you feel that way...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's just how things are now,[n]but if we keep doing stuff like[n]this, that will definitely change.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We simply need to devote[n]ourselves to the cause. Our[n]praise will come later.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm sure some people out[n]there will understand.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh. I guess we just gotta act[n]like modest heroes for now...
